purpose: Prevent historical or superseded contracts from being mistaken for current runtime authority while preserving immutable evidence.

rules.historical_contract_policy: PRESERVE_IMMUTABLY; NEVER TREAT AS CURRENT WITHOUT FRESH EXACT-CURRENT EVIDENCE

known_historical_contracts.reason: The contract records an earlier exact-runtime primitive and does not match the current canonical runtime anchor. It must remain preserved as history and must not be used as current runtime evidence.

promotion_rule: A contract classification never grants promotion. Promotion requires fresh evidence owned by the relevant admission gate.
immutability_rule: Do not rewrite historical action logs or historical contract evidence to make them appear current. Add a new classification/index record instead.
